Name: Tenkai Hereditary Children
Author: TENKAITENSHI
Description:
[size=5][b]Tenkai Hereditary Children[/b][/size]

[b]Family-inspired children, individual styles and visible growth.[/b]

Children can share a family without looking like copies. Tenkai Hereditary Children provides baby and child designs inspired by Stardew Valley's twelve original marriage candidates. Each child keeps their own family, hairstyle, outfit set, finish and birthday, with a visual growth stage selected as time passes.

First Nexus release: [b]1.6.4[/b]. Public author: [b]Tenkai Tenshi[/b].

[size=4][b]Twelve families[/b][/size]

Abigail, Emily, Haley, Leah, Maru, Penny, Alex, Elliott, Harvey, Sam, Sebastian and Shane.

Each family has its own hair, eye and skin palette and clothing inspired by its NPC parent. These are family presets, not a genetic blending calculation between the farmer and NPC. Boys and girls have separate designs once they walk. Babies use one family design shared by both genders.

[size=4][b]Distinct siblings[/b][/size]

Each family and gender has five hairstyles and five family outfit sets, combined with three finishes: Classic, Explorer and Creative. That gives 75 combinations per family, gender and growth stage.

Boys: Original, Short, Curly, Quiff and Side Part. Girls: Original, Bob, Pigtails, Braid and Bun.

Automatic hair and outfit allocation is grouped by family, gender and owning farmer. Least-used choices are assigned first, so the first five siblings receiving new selections get variety before repeats. Existing and manual choices are respected and may include duplicates. Later siblings receive balanced repeats. Hair, outfit set and finish are independent choices and survive saving and loading.

[size=4][b]Babies and four growth stages[/b][/size]

Early baby phases follow the original game's progression. Once the child reaches the game's walking phase, one of four appearances is selected from their individual age:

- Small child: under 3 years.
- Child: 3 to under 5 years.
- Older child: 5 to under 8 years.
- Preteen: age 8 and up.

By default, [b]112 in-game days equal one year of age[/b]. From birth, the 3-, 5- and 8-year thresholds are 336, 560 and 896 days. Age keeps increasing after eight, while the final appearance stays the same. There is no adult stage.

Each child has a stored birthday. For existing children without one, the date is inferred from their days alive and saved. You can inspect or correct their age and birthday. Changing growth age does not force a baby to skip the original baby phases or rewrite vanilla daysOld. The birthday calendar still uses 28-day seasons.

[size=4][b]How family assignment works[/b][/size]

The mod uses a confirmed NPC parent stored on the child. It also understands historical Free Love and Polyamory Sweet parent tags. At a birth with one valid spouse, it can record that family automatically. These other mods are optional and are not bundled or required.

Older children with no confirmed family may need a manual assignment. A retained historical appearance is not proof of parentage. Use child_list to inspect the data and child_set_parent to confirm the family.

Personality in this version is [b]visual[/b]: family traits, hairstyles and clothes. It does not add dialogue, tastes, school, jobs, new schedules, extra births or a multiple-spouse system. It does not increase the game's child limit.

[size=4][b]Requirements and installation[/b][/size]

- Stardew Valley for PC, version 1.6 branch. Build reference: 1.6.15.
- SMAPI: https://smapi.io/ . Use the current SMAPI release compatible with your game; the local reference is SMAPI 4.5.2. The manifest declares 4.0.0 as its minimum, but older releases have not been verified here.
- Content Patcher, Generic Mod Config Menu and other child mods are not required.

1. Back up your save and close the game before installing or updating.
2. Extract the main ZIP into Stardew Valley/Mods. You should have Mods/HereditaryChildren/manifest.json beside the DLL and assets folder.
3. Keep one copy with UniqueID Tenkai.HereditaryChildren.
4. Launch through SMAPI, load your save and run child_list in the SMAPI console.
5. Confirm existing children's families if needed, then save normally to retain changes.

Preserve config.json when updating and avoid nested duplicate mod folders. The mod creates its configuration on launch; the download does not include a personal configuration.

[size=4][b]SMAPI commands[/b][/size]

Use the SMAPI console, not the in-game chat. Replace Luna with your child's actual name. Names containing spaces are supported: write the full name without adding quotation marks. Duplicate child names are rejected to avoid changing the wrong child. Commands that change data require the host player.

[code]child_list
child_age Luna
child_set_parent Luna Abigail
child_set_gender Luna girl
child_set_hair Luna 3
child_set_wardrobe Luna 2
child_set_outfit Luna creative
child_set_age Luna 5
child_set_birthdate Luna 5 spring 1
child_refresh[/code]
child_set_mother is an alias for child_set_parent. child_hairstyles, child_wardrobes and child_outfits list the options. Gender accepts boy or girl; hairstyle and outfit set accept 1–5. Finishes accept classic, explorer and creative, plus Spanish equivalents. Birthdays accept days 1–28 and English or Spanish season names. Future dates are rejected. Years zero or below can represent births before the farm's first year. Save normally after changing persistent selections.

[size=4][b]Growth speed[/b][/size]

With the game closed, edit config.json:

[code]{
  "GrowthDaysPerYear": 112
}[/code]
The supported range is 7–1120 days per growth year; invalid values fall back to 112. Changing this value recalculates existing children's growth ages without changing season length. The host's value is used in multiplayer. There is no in-game configuration menu included.

[size=4][b]Compatibility and scope[/b][/size]

The reference environment is Windows, Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.5.2. Validation on macOS, Linux, Steam Deck, Android and multiplayer has not been completed. No console version is provided. In multiplayer, everyone should install the same release; the host manages persistent changes.

Other mods that replace child sprites, drawing, growth or child characters may conflict. Recognizing another mod's parent tags does not guarantee compatibility between two child overhauls. Custom NPC families are not included.

Age and birthday metadata do not turn the child into a fully scheduled NPC. [b]SMAPI messages are currently in Spanish[/b]; this release includes English and Spanish documentation, not a full English translation of in-mod messages.

[size=4][b]FAQ[/b][/size]

Why is a child unrecognized? Check child_list. If the confirmed family is missing or tags conflict, use child_set_parent with one of the twelve supported NPCs and save.

Why do existing siblings still look alike? Stored selections are respected. Change their hair and outfit set independently with child_set_hair and child_set_wardrobe.

Why does setting age five not make a baby walk? The mod preserves the vanilla baby phase. The four growth appearances apply once the game considers the child a walker.

Can I remove it? Close the game and back up your save, then remove the HereditaryChildren folder. Custom appearances and visual growth stop applying; existing mod metadata stays in the save and is ignored. Explicit changes to vanilla fields, such as gender through a command, are not automatically undone.

[b]AI disclosure:[/b] OpenAI Codex was used for C# code, tooling and documentation. OpenAI image generation was used for sprite resources and clothing references, which were adapted with sprite-compositing tools. Publication images display actual pixels from the packaged sprites, enlarged without smoothing. They are presentation boards, not in-game screenshots. Apply the AI-Generated Content and AI Media tags to this publication.

[size=4][b]Initial Nexus release 1.6.4[/b][/size]

Includes twelve families, five hairstyles and five outfit sets per gender, three finishes, individual birthdays and four visual growth stages. It incorporates the current face, hair/arm layering, torso/neck continuity, fringe-gap, profile and girls' walking-cycle corrections.

File, sprite and regression checks are not a guarantee of every combination in live gameplay. Broader compatibility and in-game visual acceptance remain under review.
